def maxCandies(status: List[int], candies: List[int], keys: List[List[int]], containedBoxes: List[List[int]], initialBoxes: List[int]) -> int:
    total_candies = 0
    open_boxes = set(initialBoxes)
    available_keys = set()

        current_box = open_boxes.pop()
        total_candies += candies[current_box]

        available_keys.update(keys[current_box])

                open_boxes.add(box)

                available_keys.discard(box)  # Remove the key if the box is still closed

        total_candies += candies[current_box]

        available_keys.update(keys[current_box])
        
        # Add contained boxes to open_boxes if they are open or we have the key
        for box in containedBoxes[current_box]:
            if status[box] == 1 or box in available_keys:

    return total_candies
